press_references.value: Fintech founder charged with fraud after ‘AI’ shopping app found to be powered by humans in the Philippines

legal_proceedings.description: Albert Saniger, founder and former CEO of Nate, was charged with defrauding investors by falsely claiming that the AI shopping app was powered by artificial intelligence, when it was actually operated by humans in the Philippines. The U.S. Department of Justice announced the charges, highlighting the deception involved in raising over $50 million from investors.

legal_proceedings.description: The SEC charged Albert Saniger, founder and former CEO of Nate, with fraudulently raising over $42 million by misrepresenting the company's use of AI. Nate ceased operations in January 2023, leaving investors with substantial losses.
